description: Build the images and hand the project to the platform. Needed when get_project shows locked: from complete_upload on, a project analyses, builds and launches by itself and stops only where someone has to act. In any other state this answers with the state, or refuses with what has to happen first. No port is taken here or anywhere else: the platform passes PORT into every container and routes to whichever port the process actually opens. Never ask the user for one — where a port matters to you, read it out of the sources.
name: deploy
title: Build and deploy
